thread:
maria: Heads-up: hit an odd one in canary -- after DMA offload a few pages show CRC mismatch on GPU-side. Not full OOM, just partial page corruption flags from the driver. Threading this here for design ideas on safe repair/retry path.
aj: yikes. do we have repro? which allocator path? offload vs staging?
maria: Repro: small-batch inference on dedicated. Sequence: kvcache miss -> host-offload(zdma) -> later attempt to reattach KV shows checksum mismatch. Affected pages mapped as 'dev-corrupt' by nv driver logs. I'll paste logs.
maria: ```
[ 2026-03-20 14:02:11.234 ] nv_dma: import_page 0x7fb3a1f000 crc=0x1a2b3c FAIL
[ 2026-03-20 14:02:11.235 ] runtime: offload complete tenant=t-42 batch=314 seq=17 pages=3
[ 2026-03-20 14:02:11.400 ] nv_dma: remap attempt 1 -> mismatch
```
devon: Possible that DMA completion raced with async compact? We should avoid re-importing corrupted pages; need repair path that falls back to recompute or re-fetch from model shard.
kevin: Agree. Proposal: when driver reports corruption on import, runtime should mark page as 'tainted', evict any dependent entries, and return an error to request path that triggers recompute fallback. Also emit telemetry: page fingerprint, tenant, batch-id.
nina: We also need a safe repair RPC for Dedicated/Private: admin can attempt 'reimport-and-validate' which does zero-copy reimport with driver quirk fixes. But we must gate it behind lease to avoid concurrent reuse.
aj: Edge: what if corrupted page is part of kvcache whose refcount >1? Replacing could race. Add per-page repair lock and version tokens. Basic semantics: repair succeeds -> bump page version -> reconcile refs; repair fails -> replace with empty placeholder and force recompute.
devon: What's the state machine? I'd sketch: DETECT->TAINT->TRY-REPAIR (best-effort, nonblocking) -> ON SUCCESS: ATTEST->SWAP->UNTAINT->NOTIFY; ON FAIL: QUARANTINE->REPLACE_WITH_ZERO->SCHEDULE_RECOMPUTE. Also ensure we don't re-add to kvcache until attest.
kevin: Telemetry: increment corrupt_count, attach stack trace of last offload, and count of remap attempts. Also add alert when tenant corrupt_rate > threshold. We'll need a new metric.
maria: Sounds good. One more: offline analysis. Add artifact (page fingerprint + nvlog) to S3 with TTL. Helps postmortems.
evictor-bot: deploybot: rolling canary to runtime-v2.14.1 started. Monitor corrupt_count.
aj: :thumbsup: I'll sketch the API changes: page_meta.flags += 'tainted' + repair_locked bool; kvcache control paths check flags; expose admin 'repair_page(page_id)' RPC.
nina: I'll add lease semantics to the repair RPC - returns 5s repair token. Also need to document in Private deployment notes (operator playbook + safety checklist).
maria: Ok assigning: aj -> API RFC, devon -> state machine impl, kevin -> telemetry + alerts, nina -> admin repair RPC + docs. I'll make a follow-up RFC PR tomorrow. Thanks.
